entry.title: Transaction rate-limiting
entry.summary: The discussion revolves around the practical application and observation of a peer-observer dashboard, which is currently being used to monitor certain node activities. Specifically, there’s an operational strategy in place that involves running a 31.x node alongside several master/v32.0 nodes. This setup is intended to facilitate comparisons and provide insights should similar situations arise in the future. The emphasis on using diverse node versions suggests a proactive approach to managing and diagnosing system behaviors, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of the monitoring process.
